items.title: Earl May interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2001
items.q: So when Trane asked me to play on a record date with him, to make a record date, boy I was—

ctx.x: Right. This, wow — they made some great records too.
Yeah, they sure did. So when Trane asked me to play on a record date with him, to make a record date, boy I was—
Now would you get together and rehearse for something like that?
